channel.title: NOIR ROAST | South Indian Specialty Coffee Roastery Dispatches
channel.description: Fresh seasonal small-batch roast releases, harvest cupping scores, and terroir updates from Chikmagalur, Coorg, and Indiranagar Bengaluru.

item.title: Monsoon Harvest Drop: Baba Budan Obsidian 96h Anaerobic
item.description: Direct from Mullayanagiri slopes at 2,100m ASL. Tasting notes of floral jasmine, cardamom bloom, and bittersweet Mysore cacao slow-roasted in 12kg convection drums.

item.title: Cask Fermentation Archive: Dakshin Reserve 1998
item.description: Master assemblage of Chikmagalur and Coorg estate beans aged in charred oak casks for heavy jaggery caramel and smoked vanilla body.

item.title: Rare Geisha Release: Nilgiri Blue Mountain 2,250m ASL
item.description: Sub-alpine high elevation Geisha micro-lot processed with 120h carbonic maceration for extraordinary jasmine perfume and Meyer lemon clarity.
